criteria.criterion: `vloop intervention migrate` rewrites every v1 record under .vloop/interventions/ by inserting `schema: intervention/v2`, `options: 0`, `recommended: 0`, `decided: ""` and `agreement: no-options` right after `by:`, and changes no other byte of the file; `recorded` and `backfilled` are left as they are. Violation to rule against: a migration that re-renders the record, normalises whitespace, or touches the body.
criteria.evidence: internal/intervention/intervention.go migrateText splits with SplitAfter and appends the five lines to the by: line only; TestInterventionMigrate compares byte for byte against a record with trailing spaces and backfilled: true

criteria.criterion: It prints `migrated <n> record(s)`, or `nothing to migrate` when no record is v1, and is idempotent; v2 records are left byte for byte.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/intervention.go prints both messages; the test asserts both outputs and an unchanged file on the second run; records with a schema: line return ok=false

criteria.criterion: `--dry-run` lists the files it would migrate and writes nothing.
criteria.evidence: Migrate skips WriteFile when dryRun; the test asserts the listed name and that the file is unchanged

criteria.criterion: `vloop upgrade` neither calls migrate nor rewrites any record.
criteria.evidence: the diff does not touch the upgrade code; TestUpgradeLeavesV1InterventionAlone asserts the file is unchanged after upgrade --yes

criteria.criterion: Committed tests cover the byte-for-byte insertion, the dry run, idempotence, and that upgrade leaves a v1 record alone.
criteria.evidence: internal/cli/intervention_test.go TestInterventionMigrate and internal/cli/upgrade_test.go TestUpgradeLeavesV1InterventionAlone; the go check passed

notes: Migration only; docs/guide/commands.md updated. No pre-existing tests were modified. none.
